messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands still, then briefly raises his arms and shifts his stance before returning to a relaxed standing pose.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium shot frames the man from the knees up, centered in the frame.","clothing":"He wears a white tank top with a purple palm-tree graphic and “Los Angeles” text, white shorts, and white sneakers.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair cropped close to the head.","identity":"A young adult male with a slim build and short dark hair stands facing the camera in a 3D-rendered scene.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic city plaza at night, with a large glass building, a glowing circular neon sign, and a wet, reflective ground surface."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a daytime cobblestone street with British flags and historic buildings to a futuristic glass-fronted plaza with a large circular neon sign, wet reflective ground, and pink/cyan lighting. The person's skin and clothing now show strong pink/red lighting, matching the new environment. The person's pose and general action sequence remain similar, and the camera remains a centered medium shot.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original street scene with the reference futuristic plaza environment, including its lighting effects on the person, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was preserved exactly, since the new lighting and resolution make subtle expression comparison difficult.
unexpected_changes: The person's shorts appear more saturated pink in the output, though this may be due to the new lighting.
